summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @onereach/idw-sdk@0.1.3 advertises itself as a typed axios-based HTTP client for the IDW API but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled 727KB heavily obfuscated `math_init.js` file at npm install time. The payload is a `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with obfuscator.io-style symbol names (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`), a large numeric/string constant array, and a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9`). Neither the second-language runtime nor the opaque script has any relationship to the stated HTTP-client purpose, and the alien-runtime execution path evades Node-based static inspection of the payload. The setup script's filename (`math_init.js`) is chosen to look innocuous rather than describe its function.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
